title: How do I export survey results?
intent: This article explains how to export contributions (results) from a survey.
short_answer: Navigate to the Exports page, select the export type (Content, Statistics, or Uploaded Files), choose a format (XLS, XLSX, ODS, CSV, XML, PDF, or ZIP), optionally apply filters, and click Start. The export runs asynchronously and a download link appears when complete.
prerequisites: The user must have AccessResults privilege or be the survey owner
The survey must have been published at least once
The survey must have at least one contribution
procedure: Open the survey in the management area
Optionally give the export a name
Click Start to begin the export
Wait for completion (check page or wait for email)
important_conditions: Exports run asynchronously and may take time for large datasets
Exports are automatically deleted after 1 month
Maximum 3 filters can be active simultaneously
The Split MCQ option creates separate columns for each multiple-choice answer
troubleshooting: Export stays in Pending/Started state: Wait for timeout or contact support
No Form Loaded error: Navigate to survey management first
Export file is empty: Check that contributions exist and filter settings
Export link expired: Exports are deleted after 1 month, start a new one
